nakshatraHub.title: Baby Names by Nakshatra: All 27 Birth Stars & Syllables
nakshatraHub.description: Find baby names for all 27 nakshatras (birth stars): the four pada syllables of each, the rashi they fall in, and Hindu boy and girl names that start with them.
nakshatraHub.intro: In the Hindu naming ceremony (namkaran), a baby's name traditionally begins with the syllable of the pada (quarter) of the nakshatra the Moon was in at birth. Each of the 27 nakshatras has four padas, so there are 108 naming syllables. Pick your baby's birth star to see its syllables and matching names.

rashiHub.title: Baby Names by Rashi (Moon Sign): All 12 Rashis
rashiHub.description: Baby names for all 12 rashis (moon signs), from Mesha (Aries) to Meena (Pisces): the naming syllables of each rashi and Hindu boy and girl names that start with them.
rashiHub.intro: Each rashi (moon sign) covers nine nakshatra padas, so it has up to nine naming syllables. Many families choose a name from any syllable of the baby's rashi when the exact nakshatra syllable gives too few options.
